package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"sync"
)

var (
	mu       sync.Mutex
	lastName string
)

// byeHandler keeps the name in a package-level variable and has no default name.
func byeHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	lastName = r.URL.Query().Get("name")
	fmt.Fprintf(w, "Goodbye, %s!", lastName)
}
